reports.title: Offchain Nitro Security Assessment (Trail of Bits, first Nitro review, 2022)
reports.description: Sixteen person-week Trail of Bits review of the Arbitrum Nitro repository covering the Rust arbitrator and WAVM, the Go ArbOS (including its go-ethereum modifications), the L1 Solidity contracts in solgen and a partial look at ArbNode, at several commits reviewed during the engagement. External libraries, most node directories and the system economics were out of scope.

versions.coverage: Manual review and differential fuzzing of WASM parsing/validation, WASM-to-WAVM conversion, machine.step execution and proof serialization/hashing in the arbitrator; external libraries (SoftFloat, wasm glue code) were not reviewed. The five WAVM High findings target arbitrator/prover/src/machine.rs.

Manual review and fuzzing of ArbOS message handling, asset/escrow flows, gas accounting, retryable tickets, precompiles and the go-ethereum modifications; ArbOS Merkle accumulator, internal storage and economics were not reviewed. The report reviewed both listed arbos commits and does not state per-commit finding status; the two High findings (arbos/block_processor.go, arbos/tx_processor.go) are recorded on both.

versions.review_phase: review of updated code during the engagement
versions.coverage: Manual review and fuzzing of ArbOS message handling, asset/escrow flows, gas accounting, retryable tickets, precompiles and the go-ethereum modifications; ArbOS Merkle accumulator, internal storage and economics were not reviewed. The report reviewed both listed arbos commits and does not state per-commit finding status; the two High findings (arbos/block_processor.go, arbos/tx_processor.go) are recorded on both.

Manual review focused on Inbox, SequencerInbox, Bridge, the OneStepProver/OSP contracts (interactions with ChallengeManager and deviations from the arbitrator), Rollup staking/challenge logic and ChallengeManager; mocks, precompile interfaces and test helpers were not the focus. The revision already includes the PR #294 fix named by the report. High findings target solgen/src/osp/OneStepProver0.sol (WAVM 1-5), solgen/src/libraries/AdminFallbackProxy.sol (SC-1) and solgen/src/challenge/ChallengeManager.sol (SC-8, SC-9, SC-10).

reports.title: Arbitrum Nitro Security Assessment (Trail of Bits, second Nitro review, 2022)
reports.description: Sixteen person-week Trail of Bits review of Arbitrum Nitro before mainnet migration, covering the Go ArbOS (pricing, gas, migration and AnyTrust DAS validation), the bridge contracts and HashProofHelper in nitro/contracts, and the NitroMigrator contract in the classic repository. Validator, arbitrator/prover, DAS server and cryptographic code were out of scope.

versions.coverage: Manual review and fuzzing of ArbOS message handling, asset flows, EVM state translation, L1/L2 pricing models, opcode gas changes, retryable tickets and Classic-to-Nitro migration code; the Brotli and zeroheavy codecs and cryptographic primitives were not reviewed. High findings target arbos/tx_processor.go (TOB-ArbOS-3) and arbos/internal_tx.go (TOB-ArbOS-4).
Reviewed for sequencer message and DAS certificate parsing as part of the AnyTrust differences; High finding TOB-ArbOS-17 targets this file.
Review of Inbox, SequencerInbox and Bridge focused on changes since the March 2022 audit and their post-migration interactions with ArbOS.
Manual review and Echidna invariant testing of the preimage proof helper.

reports.title: Arbitrum Chains Challenge Protocol v2 Security Assessment (Trail of Bits, 2023)
reports.description: Twenty engineer-week Trail of Bits review of the in-development challenge protocol v2 (BoLD) repository, covering the Solidity challenge edge and assertion chain contracts, the Go prefix/inclusion proof utilities and the offchain validator edge tracker and challenge watcher, with a fix review appendix. All High findings are in the Go validator and proof utility code; the Solidity contracts received only Low and Informational findings.

versions.coverage: Weekly review of the evolving challenge edge contracts and libraries (EdgeChallengeManager, EdgeChallengeManagerLib, ChallengeEdgeLib, MerkleTreeLib proof utilities) across the eleven listed commits from the first to the last; proxies and integration with the wider Arbitrum system were not reviewed. Only Low/Informational/Undetermined findings were located in these contracts; all High findings are in the Go validator code.

Review of assertion creation, staking and confirmation in the assertion chain (RollupUserLogic, RollupCore) across the eleven listed commits; assumptions around assertion creation and inbox interaction were noted as unclear. Only Low/Informational findings were located here.
PR #321 head verifying the fix for TOB-ARBCH-32 in RollupUserLogic.sol.
PR #344 head verifying the fix for TOB-ARBCH-34 in RollupCore.sol.

reports.title: Offchain Labs AIP 1.1 and 1.2 Security Assessment Summary Report (Trail of Bits, May 2023)
reports.description: One-week Trail of Bits review of the governance contracts implementing AIP 1.1 and 1.2: the ArbitrumFoundationVestingWallet, the L2AddressRegistry and the AIP1Point2Action action contract, with a fix review appendix. Only one Low and two Informational findings were reported.

versions.coverage: Manual review of vesting, release, migration and access controls against the AIP 1.1 specification, plus tests and deployment scripts.
PR #50 head adding the contract-existence check for TOB-AIP-3; TOB-AIP-1 (Low) remains acknowledged/unresolved.
Manual review for correctness, immutability of registered addresses, deployment with the right addresses, tests and scripts.
Manual review against the AIP 1.2 specification (proposal thresholds and constitution hash) and the action contract guidelines.

reports.title: Arbitrum Governance Security Assessment (Trail of Bits, governance and token bridge, 2022)
reports.description: Twenty-two person-week Trail of Bits review (October to December 2022) of the Arbitrum DAO governance contracts (token, distributor, timelocks, governor, vesting wallets, upgrade executor and factories) at three commits and of the token bridge contracts with focus on the new reverse custom gateways. Nitro core contracts were out of scope; the single High finding is in the L2ArbitrumGateway.

versions.coverage: Manual and static review of the governance contracts (L1ArbitrumToken, TokenDistributor, FixedDelegateErc20Wallet, L1ArbitrumTimelock and factory, L2ArbitrumGovernor and factory, ArbitrumVestingWallet and factory, UpgradeExecutor, ArbitrumTimelock) and their auxiliary code; the report reviewed the three listed commits as the code evolved and does not state per-commit finding status. No High findings in this repository.

reports.title: Offchain Labs Security Council Elections Security Assessment Summary Report (Trail of Bits, August 2023)
reports.description: One-week Trail of Bits review of the Security Council election contracts (nominee and member election governors, member removal governor and SecurityCouncilManager) in the governance repository at two commits plus the PR #150 ordering changes. One Medium, one Low and three Informational findings were reported.

versions.coverage: Manual review and differential fuzzing of the nominee election, member election and member removal governors and the SecurityCouncilManager against the Constitution and the election specification; deployment and activation scripts were only superficially reviewed.

versions.review_phase: review of updated code during the engagement
versions.coverage: Manual review and differential fuzzing of the nominee election, member election and member removal governors and the SecurityCouncilManager against the Constitution and the election specification; deployment and activation scripts were only superficially reviewed.
Review of the election-ordering changes in PR #150 (head commit), which introduced the Medium finding TOB-ASC-3.

reports.title: Offchain Labs Governance Actions Security Assessment Summary Report (Trail of Bits, August 2023)
reports.description: One-week Trail of Bits review of miscellaneous governance action contracts (L1 pricing fix, sweep receiver, L1 timelock fix), small changes to the Security Council election contracts and their activation actions, the ArbOS upgrade action contracts, and the Nitro contract changes between v1.0.2 and v1.0.3-beta.0. Only one Low and two Informational findings were reported.

versions.coverage: Review of the Fix L1 Pricing (UpdateGasChargeAction), Set New Sweep Receiver (SetSweetReceiverAction) and Fix Core L1 Timelock (UpdateL1CoreTimelockAction) action contracts against the action contract guidelines and their intended effects; deployment values could not be verified.
Only the fix for the incorrect msg.value usage in _execute (the code upgraded by the Fix Core L1 Timelock action) was reviewed.
Review of a number of small changes to the Security Council election contracts since the earlier review, looking for newly introduced flaws.
Review of the Security Council activation action contracts for adherence to the action contract guidelines and correct granting/revoking of permissions.
Review of the ArbOS upgrade action contracts (setting the WASM module root and scheduling the ArbOS version upgrade); the ArbOS code being upgraded was not reviewed.

Only the Nitro contract changes between release v1.0.2 (a68783436b5105a64f54efe5fbd55174704a7618) and v1.0.3-beta.0 were reviewed for newly introduced flaws; neither version was comprehensively audited.
